name: Duration
definition: Elapsed time between a compatible start timestamp and end timestamp. Duration can be computed from (opened_at→closed_at) in incident data or (start_date→end_date) in goal data. Some finance CSVs have pre-computed processing_time columns.

name: Timestamp
definition: A point in time used for ordering, filtering, and aggregation. Train data contains 10 distinct time columns across 22 groups: opened_at, closed_at, sys_updated_on, processed_date, start_date, end_date, purchased_on.

name: Entity
definition: A distinct identifiable record in the dataset. Each CSV row represents an entity: an incident ticket, a finance expense line, an asset record, a goal, or a system user. All main tables have 500 rows (entities).
